2609.18278.title: Building Trust in Artificial Intelligence: A Necessity for Railway Applications
2609.18278.paper_summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is currently only applied to non-safety critical applications due to the strict standards and regulations for railway industries. We propose to review the three main fields necessary to increase trust in data science and AI algorithms and reach compliance: robustness, Operational Design Domain (ODD), and explainability. Robustness is the ability of an AI system to maintain its level of performance under any circumstances (ISO24029). ODDs allow the explicit definition of operating conditions under which a system is intended to operate, according to the recently published DIN DKE SPEC 99004. Explainability is the property of an AI system to express important factors influencing the AI system results in a way that humans can understand. Those 3 domains of research are already well investigated by nonrailway actors, with algorithms and methods ready to use for railway applications. A system view is necessary to ensure all trustworthy requirements interact continuously in a safe MLOps environment thereby fostering acceptance from regulators, operators and the public. Beyond safeguarding safety-critical applications, we aim to show that fostering deep trust in AI, as now required by regulatory frameworks worldwide, will unlock its full potential and transform the pace of adoption across mission-critical domains.
2609.18278.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧（AI）目前僅應用於非安全關鍵的應用，因為鐵路行業有嚴格的標準和法規。我們提議回顧三個主要領域，以增加對數據科學和AI算法的信任並達到合規性：穩健性、操作設計範疇（ODD）和可解釋性。穩健性是指AI系統在任何情況下保持其性能水平的能力（ISO24029）。根據最近發布的DIN DKE SPEC 99004，ODD允許明確定義系統預期運行的操作條件。可解釋性是指AI系統以人類能理解的方式表達影響AI系統結果的重要因素的特性。這三個研究領域已被非鐵路參與者充分研究，並有算法和方法可供鐵路應用使用。系統觀點是必要的，以確保所有值得信賴的要求在安全的MLOps環境中持續互動，從而促進監管機構、運營商和公眾的接受。除了保護安全關鍵應用外，我們的目標是顯示，促進對AI的深度信任，如今全球監管框架所要求的，將釋放其全部潛力並改變在任務關鍵領域的採用速度。
